observations: Photo 0 shows a Sigma-branded zoom lens with a Canon-style mount (rear mount visible).
Photo 0 has visible focal range markings including '12' and '24' on the barrel.
Photo 1 shows the front glass with visible reflections; no obvious cracks or heavy haze seen.
Photo 2 shows the side of the lens with text that appears to include '12-24' and 'SIGMA'.

read_from: photo 0 barrel markings (12–24) and Sigma branding
photo 2 side text appears to include 12-24 and Sigma

claims.claim: US used Sigma 12-24 mm lens for Canon camera.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows Sigma branding and 12–24 markings; rear mount appears consistent with Canon EF-style.

claims.claim: The lens looks new and in perfect working condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show cosmetic condition, but no photo/video of autofocus, zoom smoothness, stabilization (if any), or aperture operation.

risks.risk: Wrong mount compatibility (e.g., not actually Canon EF, or not the exact mount the buyer has).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear mount contacts + the exact mount label (or a photo of it mounted on the buyer’s camera model).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as Canon-compatible but with mount risk treated as a potential mismatch (worst-case: buyer may need a different mount/return).

risks.risk: Optical issues not obvious in photos (fungus, internal haze, scratches, or coating damage).
risks.proof: A short video through the lens at wide open and stopped down, plus a close-up of the front and rear elements under bright light.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed perfect optics (worst-case: assume minor optical wear).

risks.risk: Mechanical issues (zoom ring stiffness, focus motor/AF problems, aperture not responding).
risks.proof: Test clip: autofocus on a moving subject + zoom in/out while recording; show aperture changes (EXIF/aperture display) if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed working perfectly (worst-case: treat as needing service/possible AF or aperture faults).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (front/rear caps, hood, box) affecting value.
risks.proof: Photos showing all included items laid out (front cap, rear cap, hood, pouch/box).
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming minimal accessories (worst-case: only the lens).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rear mount with contacts and any mount label (Canon EF vs other).
Video test: autofocus (or manual focus behavior), zoom smoothness, and aperture response on a camera.
Close-up photos of front and rear elements under strong light (to check fungus/haze/scratches).
Photo of everything included (front cap, rear cap, hood, pouch/box).
response.reason: The lens identity (Sigma 12–24mm) and likely Canon mount are visible, but the seller’s 'perfect working condition' claim cannot be verified from photos alone; decisive proof requires functional test shots/videos and confirmation of included accessories.
